title: The Laws of Thermodynamics
summary: Thermodynamics links heat, work and entropy.

key_concepts.explanation: A measure of the number of microscopic arrangements of a system.
A device that turns heat flow into work.

outline.heading: First and second law
points: Entropy of an isolated system never decreases.

outline.heading: Engines
points: No engine can be perfectly efficient.
The Carnot cycle sets the upper limit.

questions: Why can a fridge cool without breaking the second law?
